offers_products.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes, its main offering, plus some rental homes.

offers_services.reason: Mortgage, title and insurance services are ancillary to home sales; homebuilding is the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Homebuyers, including first-time buyers and families, choose and receive the homes.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells mainly to individual homebuyers; some bulk rental-community sales are minor.

recurring_revenue.reason: Homes are one-time purchases; revenue comes from new home closings, not repeat buying.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and sensitive to rates and the economy.

big_ticket.reason: A home is the largest, rarest purchase for a typical household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for built homes, a physical product, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual households buying homes.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder with land and inventory investment but outsourced subcontractor construction; not plant, fleet or network heavy.

notes: Land and lot inventory is a big capital need, so asset_heavy is a judgment call.
